title: physostegia virginiana var. parviflora
intro: Physostegia virginiana var. parviflora, commonly known as Small Whorled Pogonia, is a plant species in the Asclepiadaceae family, characterized by its unique appearance and medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Small Whorled Pogonia include expectorant and antitussive properties, helping to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
